source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The attribute port keeps the notification manager's existing conditions while expressing panel flags through toggleAttribute. In an active window, noautofocus is present unless a non-dismissed notification requests autofocus; the hidden-panel path restores that default. Both already-open and changed-anchor paths set noautohide when any displayed notification is persistent. The actual receiver is a checked XULPopupElement. These scoped flag updates do not prove native focus or popup behavior and do not replace other value-based attributes.
title: Popup notification presence flags follow active focus and displayed persistence state
